readExpr: JSON.stringify((()=>{const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('div,pre,code')].find(e=>(e.textContent||'').length>100000); if(!el) return {found:false}; const cs=getComputedStyle(el); return {found:true, tag:el.tagName, cls:String(el.className).slice(0,60), overflow:cs.overflow+'/'+cs.overflowX, maxHeight:cs.maxHeight, textLen:el.textContent.length, scrollH:el.scrollHeight, clientH:el.clientHeight, parentOverflow: getComputedStyle(el.parentElement).overflowY};})())
